build_symmetric_alignments: run the script to build symmetric word alignments for a translation dataset using fast_align and mosesdecoder
join_source_target_sentences: create a joined file by concatenating source and target language sentences with the ||| delimiter
run_forward_alignment: run fast_align in forward direction on the joined source-target text file
run_backward_alignment: run fast_align in reverse direction on the joined source-target text file
symmetrize_alignments: symmetrize forward and backward alignments using a configurable heuristic like grow-diag-final-and
